description:
Presented by National Geographic Society in partnership with Rolex. 

With new technology, deep-sea research can be made more accessible worldwide. 

Rolex and The National Geographic Society are partnering on select science-based expeditions to explore, study, and document change in the planet’s unique regions. #PerpetualPlanet. 

Narrated by Auliʻi Cravalho, #ExpeditionSavingOurSeas premieres November 13 at 9/8c on National Geographic. Streaming next day on Disney+ and Hulu.
